rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary only (PDF fetch returned 403; official lawcommission.gov.np page not retrieved): Electronic Transactions Act 2063 (2008) gives legal effect to electronic records and digital signatures and defines cyber offences; secondary 2026 law-firm brief says it remains in force as of April 2026 with a replacement Information Technology and Cyber Security Bill pending; a challenge to s.47 (publishing illegal electronic material) is reported pending at the Supreme Court.

Search summary only (law-firm blog, secondary; official text not retrieved): the Act defines personal information, sets obligations on public bodies and institutions handling it, gives consent and rectification rights, prescribes criminal penalties, and implements the Article 28 constitutional privacy right.
